research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: frozen occupations, current official biography, first speech, contemporaneous South Australian Hansard, 1999 public-works report, Auditor-General 2003 supplementary report, business history and 2003/2013 reporting reviewed. No substantive full-time schedule established.

Wine-centre chronology: 1996–2002 official label conflates the earlier wine/food tourism position and later statutory-centre CEO work. Preserve supported envelope and components; obtain SATC appointment letter/1996 annual report, project-director dates, CEO contract and separation record. Board establishment is not her personal commencement date. Public control is supported for statutory Centre, not silently backdated to 1996.

Business hours/breaks: first speech describes long hours of small business in general, insufficient for a complete full-time spell. Drought-related suspension of commercial rose growing for approximately three years is a lead from secondary summaries of Natalie Kotsios, Weekly Times, 10 November 2015, https://www.weeklytimesnow.com.au/news/politics/perfect-pathway-for-assistant-agriculture-and-water-minister-senator-anne-ruston/news-story/48eb5538e595d6c5da0d34978f5a178c . Direct article returned a No Cookies page. Do not invent closure dates or assume all tourism/management work ceased. Seek contemporaneous business interviews and operating records.

Post-entry ownership retained separately; 2019 property sale does not extend the pre-entry owner/operator spell or prove salaried directorship. Avoid misattributing uncle David Ruston’s international rose-society presidency to Anne.

Education (business degree) and any work before 1987 are not fully dated; no assumption of no prior employment. The 2002–2003 transition also needs clarification. National Wine Centre later university arrangements are not used to classify her earlier job.

Recovered source errors: SA Hansard direct PDF 403 Forbidden, AustLII committee PDF Internal Error, Weekly Times No Cookies page. Legitimately public indexed extracts and alternative primary audit/business sources supplied evidence; no access controls bypassed.

Follow-up: pre-1987 work, Wine/Tourism Council legal employer and contract; project/CEO boundaries and full-time status; business active hours, drought interruption and parental/other leave; directorship/party-role term and remuneration. Last follow-up 2026-10-01; next Rebekha Sharkie.

Follow-up2026-10-02:1996salary answer establishes remuneration and1998Estimates establishes a two-year National Wine Centre contract. Full contract, position description and renewal/separation papers remain necessary; contract tenure is not actual service duration or full-time evidence.

Contemporary1998wine-tourism conference report provides project-director corroboration. Direct Emerald InternalError and new1998Hansard403 were source-specific; indexed extracts used transparently. Targeted contract,appointment,project-director anddrought searches did not resolve earlier work, exact transition, business breaks or hours. No unsupported full-time totals. Next priority original1998contract/annual report and contemporaneous drought business interviews.

Follow-up2026-10-03: repeated exact-name contract, project-director, Wine and Food Tourism and Ruston's Roses drought searches located the already captured1998project-director observation, public LinkedIn's broad1996–2002National Wine Centre claim and secondary three-year drought narrative. None supplied a primary CEO commencement, contract renewal/separation date, drought suspension dates or substantive hours. The broad search avenue is recorded without promoting derivative chronology.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Targeted1997TourismCommission and1999appointment/2002contract searches returned previously captured1996salary answer,1999committee witness list and later parliamentary service. No original wine-centre contract, payroll transfer or separation record located. Renmark school references concern education/classmate Rick Burr, not evidence that Ruston was a teacher. Pre1987work remains unknown; institutional incorporation21August1997does not establish personal commencement. Continue next member rather than repeat exhausted broad project/drought queries.
